create_dinov2_config: create a Dinov2Config instance with default hyperparameters for the dinov2-base model
create_custom_dinov2_config: create a Dinov2Config with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
create_backbone_dinov2_config: create a Dinov2Config configured as a backbone with out_indices and out_features for feature extraction
create_dinov2_model: create a Dinov2Model initialized from a Dinov2Config instance with random weights
summarize_dinov2_config: summarize the Dinov2Config class and its configurable hyperparameters for model initialization
